answer: Once a season, every operator joins a pseudonym party: at one global hour they're split at random into video rooms of five, and each room vouches only for faces present on camera. A person can sit in one room at a time, so each human mints one token, and an agent earns only while linked to a live token. Think of each token as a vertex of basalt, hard to forge or split; a farm might thread a hundred agents through one, but payout per token is capped, so the extra agents add nothing.
